name: sysml-viz
description: A local, agent-friendly SysML v2 and GUMBO visualization engine.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @sysml-viz/core && npm run build --workspace @sysml-viz/server && npm run build --workspace @sysml-viz/cli && npm run build --workspace @sysml-viz/web
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @sysml-viz/server -- --root ../external/inspecta-scp/scp_demo_artifacts/isolette_io --library ../external/sysml-aadl-libraries" "npm run dev --workspace @sysml-viz/web"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @sysml-viz/core && npm run test --workspace @sysml-viz/server && npm run test --workspace @sysml-viz/cli && npm run test --workspace @sysml-viz/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
